sections.heading: Choose the correct store before you buy
paragraphs: The entry belongs to the store where you shop. The examples below come from Annexure A; open the full rules for each product and quantity. Products have no stated combined cash value.

sections.heading: Six prizes, with a separate winner for each
paragraphs: Check that you need the goods before increasing a basket to reach R750. A prize draw offers a chance, so do not count the prize value as a discount on your order.

sections.heading: Check the promotional products before buying
paragraphs: Annexure A lists the following variants. Use the promotional packaging and the full terms to confirm your purchase.

sections.heading: Exact gum formats in Annexure A
paragraphs: A larger or different pack is not automatically included. Use a store displaying this promotion and check the receipt before entering.

sections.heading: Decide whether the quote route fits you
paragraphs: The R650 minimum is the premium on the quote, not an amount to pay to enter as a nonclient. Consider whether you want the quote and the stated follow-up communications. Existing clients must assess the cost and suitability of additional cover separately.

sections.heading: Guardian checklist before uploading
paragraphs: Read the artwork specifications and rights/consent rules together. The work must be the learner’s own original creation. The FreeHub illustration on this page is a blank-art-supplies illustration and is not an example of an eligible entry.
Use the entry form embedded on the official News24 campaign page. A guardian should check the consent requirements before the learner uploads their artwork.

sections.heading: Initial entry and extra points
paragraphs: The email widget is the initial route. The campaign artwork encourages additional tasks for more points; those extra tasks do not all become compulsory. Check each task’s instructions and the promoter’s privacy terms.

sections.heading: How to use the child-visit benefit
paragraphs: First confirm that your chosen club has Club-V or Club-V Max for your child’s age. Ask the club about visit arrangements before making the trip.

At reception, complete the guest register and disclaimer, present the identification and guardianship evidence the club requires, then sign the child in. Existing members complete a child disclaimer for each visit.
Two visits are included. These are child-facility visits; the separate gym-membership and personal-training promotions on the same source have their own paid terms.

table.caption: Age limits stated in the October offer
rows: From six weeks old, up to nine
From six weeks old, up to 13

sections.heading: Pick a qualifying date
paragraphs: The remaining qualifying dates in the checked anniversary period are below. Recheck the official promotion before travel; only admission uses the R22 tariff.

sections.heading: Work out the total cost
paragraphs: One visitor using the R22 tariff with one R20 parking payment would pay R42 before transport, food or extras. Parking is optional, and this example is not a family-ticket bundle.

sections.heading: Buy the correct pair on one invoice
Keep the two deadlines separate
paragraphs: Buy the qualifying appliances by 31 October 2026. Submit the gift claim by 15 November 2026 with the original invoice. Gift stock is limited, so confirm availability before committing to the appliance purchase.

sections.heading: Check the selected bedset and delivery quote
paragraphs: The checked promotion includes selected Cloud Nine Dual-Flex and Maxx-Duo bedsets and Rest Assured Wimbledon bedsets. Only the variants shown on the merchant’s promotion page qualify. A brand name alone is not enough.
The offer pays up to R350 towards delivery. If the store quotes R500 for your address, the amount still payable would be R150, plus the bedset purchase price.

sections.heading: Claim with Defy, then redeem at Checkers
paragraphs: Purchase one of the qualifying dishwashers, complete the extended-warranty registration and follow the official WhatsApp claim instructions. Tafelberg currently lists DDW377, DDW257, DDW366, DDW242 and DDW246 for this benefit.
The benefit is one specified Finish 45-tablet pack, not unrestricted R289.99 store credit. Keep your proof of purchase and allow the stated 48 business hours after successful verification.

sources.label: Current Tafelberg product list and claim instructions

sections.heading: Redeem before the supplier’s stated cutoff
paragraphs: The supplier states 11:59 SAST on 31 October 2026 for coupon redemption. The separate purchase period ends at 23:59 that day. Complete the process early enough to receive and use the coupon before its earlier deadline.

table.caption: Verified Defy models marked for local delivery

paragraphs: Both models carry a Free Local Delivery tag on the checked merchant page. Confirm the quote for your address: Tafelberg covers up to R350 and you pay any excess. Other Defy appliances are not covered by this FreeHub listing.

sections.heading: Promoter clarification received on 15 October 2026
paragraphs: DocTalk confirmed the following details directly to FreeHub by email. This is a summary of the promoter’s written clarification; the private correspondence is retained by FreeHub and is not a public terms document.

There is a difference between that clarification and the public rules currently linked below. The public rules describe first-time registration and one entry per person. DocTalk’s email confirms that existing users may also enter, that an explicit competition confirmation in the app is required, and that up to 50 additional referral tickets can be earned. For existing-user eligibility and referral tickets, this listing follows that written clarification rather than the unchanged public wording. Check your entry status in the app and contact DocTalk if it does not reflect the clarified process.

sections.heading: Use the official app and keep entry separate from healthcare purchases
paragraphs: The competition requires the DocTalk ZA app and an account. A consultation, subscription or purchase is not required for entry. The app-store age ratings do not replace the competition’s minimum entry age of 18.
These store links are for DocTalk ZA. DocTalk handles registration, referrals and entry validation directly.

sources.label: DocTalk ZA on the South African Apple App Store

sections.heading: Plan for the winner’s costs and handover
paragraphs: The winner must attend the vehicle handover in Benoni. Insurance, licensing and annual registration, fuel, optional extras and delivery elsewhere are excluded. Read the rules for the full exclusions and any applicable tax responsibility.
The rules require the winner to respond within the stated notification periods. Keep your DocTalk contact details current and read the official acceptance and transfer requirements.

sections.heading: Qualifying chocolates and Mpho’s pack-size clarification
paragraphs: Mpho at ColonyHQ confirmed the qualifying-product list to FreeHub by email on 15 October 2026, then clarified that the website’s 21g Lunch Bar reference is also correct. Newer 44g and 18g packs and older 48g, 23g and 21g packs can coexist in stores. All Lunch Bar sizes qualify except Lunch Bar MAX. Lunch Bar Dream 44g and 48g were also explicitly included in the written product list.

This is a summary of written campaign-support clarification retained privately by FreeHub. The email is not a replacement public terms document. It explains the pack-size differences between the FAQ and full rules; it does not make every Cadbury product or every 80g Dairy Milk slab eligible.

sections.heading: R500,000 cash focus, one grand-prize winner
paragraphs: The official FAQ describes one grand-prize winner, drawn on 2 November 2026, who may choose R500,000 cash or an international trip for the winner and a partner to watch the Boks. FreeHub leads with the cash option. The trip is an alternative, not an additional prize awarded alongside the cash.

Source difference: clause 5.2 of the long-form terms specifies one R500,000 cash winner, while clause 6.1 lists monthly grand-prize draws ending on 1 November. The FAQ instead gives the cash-or-trip choice and a single 2 November grand draw. This listing follows the official FAQ for those points; Mpho’s written clarification is specifically the source for the pack sizes. Both public documents are linked so entrants can check the wording.

The FAQ describes flights, transfers, accommodation, activities and rugby tickets for the trip alternative, but gives no destination, travel dates or detailed itinerary. Confirm the travel arrangements and any applicable additional conditions with the promoter before choosing that option.

sources.label: Official FAQ: grand prize and 2 November draw

sections.heading: Purchase, USSD and winner-verification conditions
paragraphs: Buy two participating chocolates for each qualifying entry. Keep the receipt and wrappers: the rules describe replacement codes against a qualifying till slip and allow wrapper checks if code ownership is disputed. Use only your own RICA-registered prepaid number. USSD costs 20c per 20 seconds, free minutes do not apply, and an incomplete session may still be billed.

The rules limit prizes to one per household and include six-month prior-winner restrictions extending to specified relatives, friends or acquaintances at the same address/property or within the stated 2km radius. A previous Cadbury grand-prize win within six months before the promotion ends also affects grand-prize eligibility. Read clauses 4.2–4.4 carefully.

Cash winners need a bank account and proof of that account for EFT. Finalists must provide the requested identity, residential-address and verification documents. Keep your entry phone number current and respond promptly to the promoter’s calls. Participation includes processing of entry information and marketing messages, with the opt-out provisions described in the rules.

sources.label: Read all entry, cost and winner conditions

sections.heading: Purchase and card swipe are required
paragraphs: This is an in-store purchase competition. Buy any two Colgate, Protex or Sta-Soft products at a participating Boxer store during the campaign period and swipe your valid Boxer Rewards Club card at checkout. The till records the qualifying entry automatically.

Use a registered and activated card. The official Rewards Club page explains registration channels; registration by WhatsApp or USSD is card setup, not a separate competition entry. Each repeat entry needs a separate qualifying purchase transaction. No separate campaign entry fee or minimum rand spend is stated.

sources.label: Official Boxer Rewards Club card and registration instructions

sections.heading: Who can enter, and who cannot win
paragraphs: Entrants must be natural persons who are legal residents of South Africa, aged 18 or older, and hold a valid South African ID or Smart Card. A valid Boxer Rewards Club card must be swiped with the qualifying purchase.

The rules exclude promoter directors, members, partners, employees, agents and consultants; people controlling or controlled by the promoters; and their spouses, life partners, business partners or immediate family.
Anyone who has won any Boxer competition prize in the three months before the draw is ineligible to win. This window runs from the exact date of the previous winning draw.

sections.heading: Dates, draw and tablet collection
paragraphs: The official rules run from 00:01 on 21 September to 23:59 on 8 November 2026. They do not separately name a timezone; FreeHub treats these South African in-store campaign times as South African local time.

Twenty Lenovo Idea Tablets are awarded by an automated random draw. All winners will be drawn and announced on or before 27 November 2026. Winners are not allocated one per store, so a participating store is not guaranteed a winner.

The tablet is couriered to the Boxer store where the winner entered for an in-person handover by Boxer staff. Home delivery is not promised. The rules do not specify a model, rand valuation or included keyboard or pen; do not assume that accessories pictured on the official poster are guaranteed.

sections.heading: Prize changes, privacy and queries
paragraphs: Boxer Superstores (Pty) Ltd and Colpal are the promoters named in the rules. They may substitute a prize or part with something of comparable or greater commercial value if circumstances require, and may amend, suspend or end the competition for unforeseen circumstances beyond their control. Technical, incomplete or failed entries are subject to the published limitations.

Entry information is processed for competition administration, identity verification and prize issue under POPIA and Boxer’s privacy statement. A winner may decline or withdraw consent for publicity. The inspected rules do not give a separate winner-response deadline; do not rely on an invented one.
For campaign or card questions, use Boxer Customer Care on 08600 26937 or the contact details on the official source. FreeHub does not collect your purchase, card registration or entry.

sources.label: Read the complete Boxer & Colgate competition rules

sections.heading: Start with an eligible Vodacom number
paragraphs: The Summer promotion runs from 8 October 2026 to 31 March 2027. It covers eligible Vodacom Prepaid, Hybrid/Top-Up and Postpaid customers, including the Business categories named in the terms. Use a lawfully registered SIM and comply with applicable account and employment permissions. Non-Vodacom customers cannot participate.

You must opt into VodaBucks. Customers already opted in are automatically enrolled. The inspected Summer terms do not state a minimum age; any account and individual-reward conditions still apply. The terms allow access while roaming, but rewards may be used or redeemed only in South Africa.

sections.heading: How the three free daily plays work
paragraphs: Open the VodaPay app or dial *133# or *135# and use the Summer Scratch & Win journey after opting in. Three is the combined daily maximum across both channels. USSD allows at most one free play, and that play reduces the remaining VodaPay allocation.

For example, one free USSD play leaves up to two free VodaPay plays that day. Free plays expire at 23:59 on the day they are allocated and do not carry over. A displayed campaign link alone does not establish your eligibility.

WhatsApp TOBi and other channels are not alternative Scratch & Win routes unless the rules for a specific benefit expressly allow them. FreeHub’s outbound link opens Vodacom’s current campaign information; it does not enter you or require you to submit details to FreeHub.

sections.heading: Rewards vary: check the app or SMS
paragraphs: Possible rewards include data, minutes, bonus airtime, social bundles, partner vouchers, VodaBucks and instant prizes. A win, a specific reward and a cash value are not guaranteed. Check the exact reward and its validity in the journey or notification SMS before claiming or using it.

Vouchers and partner offers have their own restrictions and expiry. Some rewards are available only through VodaPay or a named partner. Reward bundles expire at the communicated time; unused balances do not carry over unless the specific rules allow it. Normal usage charges can apply after a bundle is depleted or expires, subject to your settings.
Rewards generally cannot be transferred unless the relevant sharing rules expressly allow it. You must meet the conditions of any other promotion you participate in at the same time.

sections.heading: Claim and bank VodaBucks before the deadline
paragraphs: Where VodaBucks must be claimed on VodaPay, claim the reward there and bank it before midnight on Friday of the same week. Other earned VodaBucks must be banked within the banking cycle shown for them; unbanked VodaBucks expire at the applicable cutoff.

Check the reward-specific expiry in the app or SMS. Do not assume that every reward lasts until the overall 31 March campaign end. If you opt out, already-earned GSM/non-GSM rewards and banked VodaBucks remain subject to their expiry, but unbanked VodaBucks are forfeited.

sections.heading: Optional paid extras are separate
paragraphs: After the free allocation, you may buy up to five additional plays per day for one VodaBucks each, subject to the journey’s limits. These are optional and are not part of the free daily allocation.

A discounted Upsize offer, if shown after a win, requires payment. You keep the original reward if you decline the Upsize. The separate Summer Spend & Get promotion starts on 18 October and has qualifying spend requirements; it is not required for the daily free-play allocation.

Free here describes the allocated plays. The terms do not quantify underlying participation or connectivity costs, and Vodacom does not accept liability for those costs. Check your tariff and any displayed charge before continuing. Avoid optional recurring products or trials unless you understand their separate prices and cancellation rules.

sections.heading: Privacy, opting out and support
paragraphs: Opting in also joins the VodaBucks programme. Vodacom processes relevant behavioural and usage information to administer qualifying goals and personalise rewards, and may share necessary information with approved service providers or partners for fulfilment under its privacy rules.
You can opt out through VodaPay, *133# or *135#, but this does not automatically stop marketing SMS messages: those need a separate available SMS opt-out. Opt back in before resuming participation.

Vodacom may withhold or reverse rewards for fraud, misuse, ineligible or reversed transactions, and may amend or end features under the published rules. Keep reward SMS messages and transaction details for queries. Call Vodacom Customer Care on 082 135; a partner may need to handle its own reward-redemption query.

sources.label: Read the complete Summer 2026/27 terms and privacy conditions

sections.heading: Use the transaction OTP
paragraphs: Generate the official app or WhatsApp OTP and present it at the transaction. It is single-use and expires after 15 minutes. The voucher belongs to its associated member. Adult account holders must have legal capacity, parents/guardians consent for linked children, and the staff restriction in the terms applies. Confirm the live app voucher before ordering.

sections.heading: How to claim
paragraphs: Link a paid booking to your Intercape loyalty account to earn future-ticket points. Points become available after departure and expire after 12 months.

sections.heading: Costs, eligibility and validity
paragraphs: Earn 5% of qualifying ticket value after discounts and redeemed points, excluding taxes/third-party fees not retained by Intercape. Each point is R1 toward tickets, not cash. Identify the purchaser's loyalty account at purchase through Intercape's own app/site/office/contact centre. Points belong to purchaser rather than passenger, become available 24 hours after scheduled departure and expire 12 months later. Redemption is on Intercape's site/app, whole points only; disclosed availability/minimums can apply. Fully points-paid tickets earn no points. Paid travel and loyalty account required; ticket prices, standard travel/cancellation terms and connection costs apply. The inspected loyalty terms do not state a membership fee. Programme serves Intercape customers, including South African routes; no SA-citizenship restriction or minimum age stated in inspected loyalty terms. Official page dates programme start to 1 September 2025; no end date published. Marketing giveaway vouchers do not earn points. Registration allows processing of account details for loyalty administration and programme notices.

sections.heading: How to claim
paragraphs: Register in the vida app and record purchases to earn points for a future order. In-store cash or card payments can earn loyalty without linking a bank card.

sections.heading: Costs, eligibility and validity
paragraphs: Current official app FAQ confirms 5% back on app-recorded transactions. Terms permit points toward part/full purchases in-app or in-store, with three-year expiry and no cash exchange. Register a profile; under-18s need guardian consent/supervision. In-store cash/card purchases can earn via the app, so linking a card is not necessary for that route; order-ahead requires linked-card payment. Paid purchases and internet-enabled app required. Current FAQ says no extra app-payment charge; normal product/banking/data costs remain. No delivery route promised. No fixed programme end date is stated. The current terms require accurate profile details and permit OTP, order, service, marketing and promotional messages. Order Ahead is for same-day collection from the selected store. Check points immediately after purchase.

sections.heading: How to claim
paragraphs: Capitec clients get 5% off a paid Greyhound booking on its own website or app on a mobile device when paying with Capitec Pay.

sections.heading: Costs, eligibility and validity
paragraphs: Capitec clients receive 5% off Greyhound tickets booked on the operator's website/app and paid with Capitec Pay. Current homepage restricts the discount to mobile-device payment and excludes payment by Capitec bank card. It applies automatically at checkout, cannot be added afterwards, and standard changes/cancellation/refund terms apply. Paid bus ticket and qualifying Capitec account/payment approval required. No coupon code. Banking/data costs remain separate; no universal discount for cash, other banks or card payments implied. Official article is dated 21 January 2026; current homepage still advertises the benefit. No fixed expiry; operator can amend/withdraw it.

sections.heading: How to claim
paragraphs: Book a free visitor ticket for the expo at Tyger Valley Centre Arena, Cape Town. Space is limited; exhibitor stands are separate.

sections.heading: Costs, eligibility and validity
paragraphs: Free visitor admission on Wednesday 28 and Thursday 29 October 2026 at Tyger Valley Centre Arena / Tyger Valley Shopping Centre, Bellville, Cape Town. Book the free visitor ticket via the official Quicket event linked by the City of Cape Town at qkt.io/BBEXPO2026. Space is limited. The ticket page lists an overall window from 08:30 on 28 October to 18:00 on 29 October, South African time. This does not promise overnight access: confirm each day's visiting timetable with the organiser. The event ends at 18:00 on 29 October. Provide the registration information requested by the ticketing service; normal data, travel, food and shopping costs remain payable. Free visitor admission does not include an exhibitor stand. The public announcement states no age or nationality restriction. Confirm availability and your booking before travelling.

sections.heading: Check membership and renewal before activating
paragraphs: Reach the required milestone in Virgin Active Rewards, select Clue Plus in the app and redeem within seven days. Existing Clue subscriptions and trials cannot be extended or combined with this reward.

You must provide payment details. After three months, Clue automatically charges its standard subscription rate unless you cancel beforehand. Check the price and cancellation process on Clue’s activation page before accepting.
